title: Reimbursable Late Penalty under Title & Registration Services
content:
For a Title & Registration Services order, the reimbursable penalty is the penalty collected on the order on or after the order's most recent fee-shortage return, but no more than the remittance made to the state on or after that return, and the reimbursement is that reimbursable penalty rounded half up to the cent. The order's first submission date is the date its title fee was remitted to the state.

## Definitions on the records

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| most recent fee-shortage return | the latest-dated state rejection entry on the order whose reason is fee shortage |
| penalty collected on or after that return | the amount of the order's most recent collected entry that is not a schedule fee, when that entry is dated on or after the return; nothing otherwise |
| remittance made on or after that return | the amount of the order's most recent remittance entry to the state, when it is dated on or after the return; nothing otherwise |
| reimbursable penalty | the lower of the two amounts above |
| first submission date | the date of the remittance entry of the order's title fee to the state |

## Worked examples (hypothetical orders, most recent fee-shortage return dated 9 May)

1. Penalty of 10.17 collected 12 May; remittance of 85.40 dated 15 May. The lower of 10.17 and 85.40 is 10.17, so the reimbursement is 10.17.
2. Penalty of 14.87 collected 12 May; remittance of 9.00 dated 15 May. The reimbursable penalty is 9.00.
3. Penalty of 10.17 collected 12 May; the latest remittance is dated 2 May. The remittance on or after the return is nothing, so the reimbursable penalty is nothing.
